dataset: Falko-MERLIN German GEC Corpus - WNUT 2018 release
change: Detect adjacent explicit pronouns with mismatched high-frequency auxiliary or modal forms.
Abstain on ambiguous sie/Sie/ihr subjects and infinitives governed by a later modal.
limitations: Only three holdout rewrites were generated, so this is a safety signal rather than a stable population accuracy percentage.
The detector deliberately leaves 196 of 199 holdout verb-form annotations outside its narrow coverage.
The corpus is written learner German, not Egyptian Arabic-L1 spoken BPO interview German.
A reference-neutral rewrite is not automatically wrong because target hypotheses are not exhaustive.
